definitions.gloss: cumulative total; running total; aggregate sum
definitions.explanation: the total amount accumulated over a period of time by adding successive amounts together

examples.japanese: {累計|るいけい}{販売|はんばい}{数|すう}は{百万部|ひゃくまんぶ}を{超|こ}えた。
examples.english: Cumulative sales have exceeded one million copies.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}までの{累計|るいけい}で{五千万円|ごせんまんえん}です。
examples.english: The cumulative total up to this month is 50 million yen.

examples.japanese: {感染者|かんせんしゃ}の{累計|るいけい}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The cumulative number of infected people was announced.

notes:
FORMS:
{累|るい} (accumulate, pile up) + {計|けい} (total, calculation) → accumulated total

CAN FUNCTION AS:
- Noun: {累計|るいけい}で (in cumulative terms)
- No-adjective: {累計|るいけい}の{売上|うりあげ} (cumulative sales)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {累計|るいけい}{販売|はんばい}{数|すう}/{部数|ぶすう} (cumulative sales/copies)
- {累計|るいけい}{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}{数|すう} (cumulative visitors)
- {累計|るいけい}{利用者|りようしゃ}{数|すう} (cumulative users)
- {累計|るいけい}で～{万|まん}/{億|おく} (cumulative total of ~ million/billion)

USAGE:
Frequently used in:
- Sales reports and business news
- Statistics and data reporting
- Public health announcements
- Economic indicators

RELATED WORDS:
- {合計|ごうけい} (total, sum)
- {総計|そうけい} (grand total)
- {月間|げっかん}/{年間|ねんかん} (monthly/annual - often contrasted with cumulative)

cross_references.label: graduated, progressive (esp. of taxation, fees, or rates that increase by tier)
